name: list_notes
summary: List notes from Notes.app, most recently modified first; returns each note's id for read_note/append_to_note. Optionally restrict to one folder.

params.name: folder
params.description: Restrict to one folder by exact name (see list_folders). Omit for all folders.

name: search_notes
summary: Search notes whose title or body contains a term (case-insensitive), newest first; returns each match's id. Restricting to a folder is recommended on large libraries — the search reads each scanned note's full body.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to find in a note's title or body (case-insensitive substring).

params.name: folder
params.description: Restrict to one folder by exact name (see list_folders). Omit for all. Recommended on large libraries to bound how many bodies are read.

name: read_note
summary: Read one note's full plain-text contents by id (from list_notes/search_notes). A locked (password-protected) note returns a placeholder.

params.name: id
params.description: Note id from list_notes or search_notes.

name: list_folders
summary: List the note folders in Notes.app by name, so a valid folder can be chosen for create_note.

name: create_note
summary: Create a note with a title and optional body, in a named folder or the default. STAGED; undo deletes the created note (matched by its title).

params.name: title
params.description: Note title (becomes the first, bold line).

params.name: body
params.description: Optional body text. Newlines are preserved as line breaks.

params.name: folder
params.description: Exact folder name to create it in (see list_folders). Omit for the default folder.

name: append_to_note
summary: Append text to an existing note by id (from list_notes/search_notes). STAGED; undo restores the note's previous contents. A locked note can't be appended to.

params.name: id
params.description: Note id from list_notes or search_notes.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to append as a new block. Newlines are preserved as line breaks.
